title: Queen Latifah Reacts to Lil Nas X Being Snubbed by BET
htmlContent:
Lil Nas X unloaded on BET on his BET Award 2022 name earlier this week, and he's got at least one supporter in Queen Latifah.

TMZ recently caught up with Latifah promoting her new film "Hustle" outside of "Jimmy Kimmel Live!"  The outlet asked her about Lil Nas X being subbed, but Jack Harlow being presented an award. He says the Lil Nas X is amazing and did not agree with him getting subbed.

The "Industry Baby" threw a couple of nuclear-starved dynamite sticks earlier this week when he accused the network of sharing in the world's problems.

Latifah stressed, however, that there are plenty of seats at any table for anyone to be included. We don't know how this will help Montero get ripped off, but at least he has the Latifah's respect!
